entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... yes, I need to make a return. I'm just so confused by the website.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?
It's Sarah Jenkins, order number 772-045-8191. It's about a helmet I bought a couple of months ago.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here. It was delivered about 65 days ago. To make sure I get this right for you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know. It's just... the wrong thing. I thought the color would be different, more of a bright white, but it's not. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out. Your policy online is so hard to understand. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you, Sarah. It sounds like it's just not the right fit for you, which is completely understandable. Let me just pull up the return eligibility for this specific item.

Alright, I've checked our policy. You are well within the 90-day return window. Since it's only been 65 days, I can approve this return for a full refund immediately. Especially for safety equipment, we want to ensure you're completely satisfied.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much!

You're very welcome. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to you. Simply attach it to the original box and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making that so easy.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
